description: Recent Google Maps reviews for a place: author, text, rating, date, owner response, plus the place summary. Give a place_id or a query. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

location.description: Optional location to disambiguate the query.

place_id.description: Google place_id (from maps-search). Provide this or query.

query.description: Place name to look up if no place_id, e.g. "Blue Bottle Coffee".

name: agentbit.maps_reviews
title: Maps Reviews (Google)
